overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, or susceptibility/calcification assessment. The main uncertainty is that cortical parietal/frontal location and minimal enhancement can occur in lower-grade IDH-mutant tumors, while multifocality, edema burden, and the nonenhancing/necrotic component favor aggressive IDH-wildtype disease.
